name: Coding
description: Build or change software in small, verifiable increments: plan, decide, build, review.
firstMove: Refine the Brief (ask about anything missing, propose acceptance criteria and constraints), then draft the Plan as small steps, and stop for the user to confirm before building.

intake.label: Goal
intake.hint: What should be true when this is done? Your own words are kept verbatim.

intake.label: Context and links
intake.hint: Issue, error output, related PRs, where in the code.

sections.title: Goal
sections.collects: What should be true when this is done, in the user's words. Changed only with the user's say-so.

sections.title: Where we left off
sections.note: The latest change only; the full history, newest first, is on the Change Log page.
sections.collects: Where the work stands: what was just done, what is next, any (you) tasks waiting on the user, and anything a fresh chat must know.

sections.title: Open questions
sections.collects: Things only the user can decide. When one is answered, record the decision and the question goes.

sections.title: Context and links
sections.collects: Where things are: the issue, upstream references, entry points in the code, the branch and PR once they exist, local tools and environments.

sections.title: Constraints and non-goals
sections.collects: Limits the work must respect, and what is deliberately out of scope. The agent proposes them; the user confirms.

sections.title: Acceptance criteria
sections.collects: Conditions that prove the goal is met, written as what will be true. The agent proposes them; the user confirms.

sections.title: Steps
sections.collects: The work, in order. Each step is sized for one chat and ends in one commit; the checkboxes under it are its tasks: chores, review comments, and jobs only the user can do, marked (you).

starter.title: Refine the Brief and draft this Plan
tasks: Propose acceptance criteria and constraints in the Brief
Draft the steps, each with its tasks

sections.collects: Out-of-scope work noticed along the way, never done in the current change. You decide what happens to each one: make it a Plan step, move it to a tracker or another workbook, or drop it.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.collects: Choices the user made or confirmed, never the agent's own suggestion until confirmed. A reversal is a new decision that supersedes the old one.

sections.title: Findings
sections.collects: Facts learned while working, with how we know; for a gap or limitation, its status and the step that handles it. A wrong one is superseded, never deleted.
Every handoff, newest first: what was done, what is next, any (you) tasks.
